description: List Wisp's settings as /config shows them for this chat: each setting's value and where it comes from (default, config, env, flag, session and so on). With filter, also what each matching setting does and the values it takes. Secrets are never shown. Changing a setting is the user's to do: point them to /config.

filter.description: Text to look for in a setting's name, label or help, such as theme or compact; leave it out to list every setting.

name: list_settings
